name: Civil-society statement on the fiscal pact (Ciudad Alternativa, Foro Ciudadano, CIPAF and others)
detail: Lists 'La baja tributación sobre la riqueza y la propiedad' among structural problems and asks for a fiscal pact; names no wealth tax.

name: Copadeba, Red Urbano Popular and allies (Oct 2024 fiscal-pact statement)
detail: Proposes inheritance and gift taxes, a luxury-goods consumption tax and a 27% dividend rate; no tax on the stock of wealth.

name: Government's 2024 fiscal-modernisation plan (Abinader)
detail: Larger contributions from high earners and more revenue from the property tax (IPI): an income and property measure, not a net-wealth tax.

name: Eduardo Jorge Prats
detail: 2014 column presents Piketty's global wealth tax in order to criticise it.

name: FES study 'Un presupuesto sin pacto' (Rosa Cañete, Nov 2025)
detail: Says large incomes and 'patrimonios' contribute proportionally less; recommends a fiscal pact and progressive reform, not a named wealth tax.
